name: VoiceStudio.sh
tagline: Cinematic audio dubbing, cloning & voice generation
description: A cinematic audio dubbing, cloning and voice generation studio. Enterprise-grade processing with AI-powered voice synthesis, 600+ language support, and self-hosted deployment.
audience: Creators, localization teams, and developers who need a serious voice workflow without renting every second of it from a hosted API.
positioning: Your Voice. Your Hardware. Your Studio.

features.title: Own the Voice Pipeline
features.description: Clone, design, generate, dub, and dictate from one desktop studio, with the models and output under your control.

features.title: Move from Clip to Production
features.description: A multi-track dubbing workflow, project library, voice gallery, and engine controls turn isolated model demos into repeatable work.

features.title: Run Where the Work Lives
features.description: Use MLX on Apple silicon, CUDA on NVIDIA, Docker on a server, or the OpenAPI surface from another tool.
